steps.name: Compromise Infrastructure
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) compromised third-party infrastructure in physical proximity to targets of interest for follow-on activities.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Wi-Fi Networks
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) established wireless connections to secure, enterprise Wi-Fi networks belonging to a target organization for initial access into the environment.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: PowerShell
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) used PowerShell cmdlet Get-ChildItem to access credentials, among other PowerShell functions deployed.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Windows Command Shell
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) used cmd.exe for execution.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Direct Volume Access
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) accessed volume shadow copies through executing vssadmin in order to dump the NTDS.dit file.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) unarchived data using the GUI version of WinRAR.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Windows Host Firewall
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) added rules to a victim's Windows firewall to set up a series of port-forwards allowing traffic to target systems.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Security Account Manager
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) used the following commands to dump SAM, SYSTEM, and SECURITY hives: reg save hklm\sam, reg save hklm\system, and reg save hklm\security.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: NTDS
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) dumped NTDS.dit through creating volume shadow copies via vssadmin.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Password Spraying
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) performed password-spray attacks against public facing services to validate credentials.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Wi-Fi Discovery
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) collected information on wireless interfaces within range of a compromised system.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Remote Desktop Protocol
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) used RDP for lateral movement.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) leveraged SMB to transfer files and move laterally.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Local Data Staging
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) staged captured credential information in the C:\ProgramData directory.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Archive via Utility
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) used built-in PowerShell capabilities (Compress-Archive cmdlet) to compress collected data.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Internal Proxy
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) used the built-in netsh portproxy command to create internal proxies on compromised systems.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) exfiltrated data over public-facing webservers – such as Google Drive.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)

steps.name: Disk Content Wipe
procedure_descriptions: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) used the native Microsoft utility [cipher.exe](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1205) to securely wipe files and folders – overwriting the deleted data using cmd.exe /c cipher /W:C.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)
